chunks: He said: Abul Hasan Ali ibn Khalid al-Maraghi reported to me, he said: Abdul Karim ibn Muhammad al-Bajali narrated to us, he said: Uthman ibn Abi Shaybah narrated to us, he said: Muhammad ibn Mus'ab al-Qarqasani narrated to us, he said: al-Awzai narrated to us, he said: Shaddad Abu Ammar narrated to us, from Wathila ibn al-Asqa, he said: The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his progeny, said:

Indeed, Allah chose Ismail from the children of Ibrahim, and chose Kinanah from the children of Ismail, and chose Quraysh from Kinanah, and chose Banu Hashim from Quraysh, and chose me from Banu Hashim.
ai.seo_question: What is the Prophet Muhammad's lineage according to hadith?
ai.summary: The Prophet Muhammad (SAWW) recounts the divine chain of selection: Allah chose Ismail from the children of Ibrahim, Kinanah from the children of Ismail, Quraysh from Kinanah, Banu Hashim from Quraysh, and finally chose him from Banu Hashim.
